The monster might be her.<BR /> Elspeth Spindle needs more than luck to stay safe in the eerie, mist-locked kingdom she calls home&mdash;she needs a monster. She calls him the Nightmare, an ancient, mercurial spirit trapped in her head. He protects her. He keeps her secrets. </P><P> But nothing comes for free, especially magic. </P><P> When Elspeth meets a mysterious highwayman on the forest road, her life takes a drastic turn.
